messages:
Kai: Quick ping : I'm doing a tiny cleanup of the Grove quickstart. Two main fixes: unify env var name to RW_API_KEY and restore the broken anchor in the deploy section.
Renee: 👍 which files need changing?
Kai: README.md, samples/.env.example, docker-compose.yml, and the JS snippet in step 2. Also CI matrix for node versions.
Marta: I can handle the README and sample changes. Note: package.json has engines set to '>=16' but our streaming SDK requires node 18+. Recommend engines: '>=18'.
Kai: Good catch. I'll add a migration note: "If you previously used REDWOOD_API_KEY, set RW_API_KEY or add RW_API_KEY=REDWOOD_API_KEY in your .env".
Renee: For the JS example, show async iterator streaming and keep it tiny. Example: 
```js
for await (const token of client.streamGenerate({model:'grove-mini', prompt})) {
  process.stdout.write(token.text)
}
```
Marta: Also fix deploy anchor: link currently /deploy/production#rolling-updates -> should be /deploy/production#rolling-updates (missing hyphen in our docs). I'll update the anchor in the TOC.
DocsBot: Link check queued for PR #7931
Kai: Branch docs/grove-compat and PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7931. Leaving notes for reviewers about node requirement and env rename.
Renee: I'll review the JS snippet and run a quick local smoke test.
Marta: CI showed a lint warning for long code line; I fixed it. DocsBot: Link check passed for PR #7931
Kai: Thanks all, aiming to merge today after Evan's review.
Renee: :eyes:
